title: Ultra Realist Craft
description: An ultra-realistic mod pack containing Patrix32x Distant Horizon and Iris to enjoy the most beautiful views of your world
body:
## Ultra Realist Craft (by Firyx Creation)

Want to completely transform Minecraft without setting your PC on fire? **Ultra Realist Craft** is built with one goal in mind: total immersion in an ultra-realistic, living world, while keeping things perfectly smooth on Fabric 1.20.1.

Every single mod has been handpicked and fine-tuned (as you can see in image_d58ca5.png) to completely overhaul your game.

### Features

* **Breathtaking view distances:** Thanks to *Distant Horizons*, you can finally see for miles across your world without destroying your frame rate. 
* **Immersive audio:** Wind blowing through trees, echoing caves, and dynamic water drops... The combination of *AmbientSounds*, *Drip Sounds*, and *Sounds* makes the world feel incredibly alive.
* **Stunning & smooth graphics:** *Sodium* and *Iris* handle the heavy lifting so you can run your favorite shaders with high FPS, while *Geophilic* makes the vanilla biome generation look much more natural and wild.
* **It's all in the details:** Physics-based capes (*Wavey Capes*), 3D skin layers (*Skin Layers 3D*), dynamic hand-held lights (*LambDynamicLights*), and seamless connected textures (*Continuity*).
* **Essential QoL:** A smooth zoom (*Zoomify*), on-screen block info (*Jade*), and detailed hunger stats (*AppleSkin*).

### 🚀 Performance First
You don't need a NASA computer to run this. The pack is heavily optimized with performance mods like *Dynamic FPS* to ensure you get the absolute best frame rates possible while pushing realism to the max.

Enjoy the pack!
